events.title: Tupac Shakur: 30 Years On
events.blurb: Commemorating 30 years since the influential rapper Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Legacy of an icon
angles.copy: Thirty years since his untimely passing, Tupac Shakur's music and message continue to resonate globally. What's your favourite track from the legend?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix: 56 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away 56 years ago today, September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Still regarded as one of the greatest guitarists of all time, Jimi Hendrix's influence remains undeniable 56 years after his passing. Which Hendrix track is essential listening for you?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album 57 years ago today, on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: That iconic cover
angles.copy: That album cover, those tracks, that legacy. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' is 57 years old. What's your favourite moment from this masterpiece?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde Turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking, still iconic. What's your top Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher Turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger. What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo hit?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' 55 years ago, on October 11, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine the impact
angles.copy: More than just a song, John Lennon's 'Imagine' still inspires peace and unity 55 years after its release. What does this iconic track mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod: 25 Years Old
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod 25 years ago, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Remember your first iPod?
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs could you fit on yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking 64 years since 'Dr. No' premiered on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, not stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' hit screens, who's your favourite 007 and what's the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon Would Have Been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the legendary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's your favourite Lennon moment?

events.title: John Cleese Turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" Turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', 58 years ago on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: The experimental White Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that broke all the rules. What are your standout tracks?

events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years On
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury, who passed away 35 years ago today.

angles.name: Still the greatest showman
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's the Queen song that always gives you chills?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' 61 years ago today, on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: A pivotal album
angles.copy: Sixty-one years of 'Rubber Soul'! This album marked a pivotal shift for The Beatles. What's your favourite track from this influential release?
